chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Nahdi, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Husayn ibn Hammad, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the one in Ihram kissing his mother. He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no problem with this; this is a kiss of mercy. What is disliked is the kiss of lust.'

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: The person in the state of Ihram (ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah)
key_terms.قُبْلَةُ الشَّهْوَةِ: Kiss of lust (kiss accompanied by sexual desire)
key_terms.يُكْرَهُ: Disliked (makruh, a category of legal ruling in Shia fiqh)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a pilgrim in Ihram to kiss their mother?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) distinguishes between the permissibility of a 'kiss of mercy' (qublat al-rahmah) and the prohibition of a 'kiss of lust' (qublat al-shahwah) for one in Ihram, highlighting that the ritual restriction targets sexual desire rather than affection. This ruling is foundational in Shia jurisprudence for understanding how Ihram nullifies certain marital acts while preserving familial bonds, reflecting the principle that the sanctity of the state is compromised by lustful intent. The distinction underscores the nuanced approach of the Ahl al-Bayt in balancing ritual purity with natural human emotions.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al Nahdy, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Aban Bin Usman, from Al Husayn Bin Hammad who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the one in Ihraam kissing his mother. Heasws said: ‘There is no problem with these kisses of mercy. But what is disliked is kisses of the lustful desires’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ahmad ibn Muhammad from has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Nahdiy from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from al-Husayn ibn Hammad who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who is in the state of Ihram and his mother kisses him. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful; it is a kiss of blessing, only kissing with lust is despised.’”
